name: ContextMenu
description: A menu shown at the pointer on right-click (long-press on touch platforms), plus the showContextMenu helper. Rows, traversal and the popup surface come from the menu component.

theme.note: ContextMenu and showContextMenu take MenuTheme/MenuPopupTheme as widget-leg overrides; no theme of their own.

accessibility.keyboard: menu traversal (ArrowUp/Down, Home/End, ArrowRight/Left for submenus, Escape, typeahead); Escape or an outside tap closes the menu
accessibility.semantics: rows are menu buttons; disabled rows dim to 50% opacity

sizes.surface: MenuPopup defaults: min-width 192 (12rem), padding 4, 1px border, radius md
sizes.offset: menu opens 8 right of the pointer

notes: ContextMenuTheme (surfaceOpacity/surfaceBlur only) is deleted with the surface* fields; MenuPopupTheme covers the surface.

The old desktop/mobile editable-text context menus (DesktopEditableTextContextMenu, MobileEditableTextContextMenu, buildEditableTextContextMenu) are not ported: the widgets-only editable text menu lives in primitives/text_editing (defaultContextMenuBuilder), so context_menu stays a pointer-positioned row menu.
The drawer dependency is gone; sheet-overlay detection uses primitives/sheet_overlay.dart.
The old module imported material.dart for TargetPlatform and platform heuristics; widgets' TargetPlatform and ThemeData.platform replace it.
The old ValueNotifier children dance (post-frame item updates) is gone: a stateless wrapper reads the current items at tap time.
